request.spec:
A person's claimed, and the sheet's claimed-total, no longer include corrections: claimed is the
amounts of the person's claims that count, leaving out claims that correct another. Everything that
reads claimed (the rollup lines included) follows; due figures are unchanged.
request.prompt:

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A person's claimed, and the sheet's claimed-total, no longer include corrections: claimed is the
amounts of the person's claims that count, leaving out claims that correct another. Everything that
reads claimed (the rollup lines included) follows; due figures are unchanged.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit

AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Corrections no longer count toward claimed. A person's claimed and the sheet's claimed-total now add up only claims that don't correct another claim. Due figures haven't changed. All 4 acceptance tests pass in `bin/e2e`.

I made the same change in the two places that calculate claimed:
- **Server** (`src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/rollup/Rollup.java`): the rollup leaves out corrections when adding up each person's claimed. The sheet's total is built from those same figures, so the `ROLLUP` and `TOTALS` audit lines follow. Due and overdue figures are still worked out from all the claims, corrections included.
- **Front end** (`src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people-list.ts`): the per-person "Claimed" column and "Claimed in total" figure leave out corrections in the same way.

Nothing else reads claimed, and no stored data or schema change was needed: each claim already records which claim it corrects.
